 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    # A horizontal 5 line separates the two panels; choose the color with
    # the larger increase in occupied cells from the upper panel to lower.
    divider = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 5 for v in row))
    upper = Counter(v for row in grid[:divider] for v in row if v not in (0, 5))
    lower = Counter(v for row in grid[divider + 1:] for v in row if v not in (0, 5))
    colors = set(upper) | set(lower)
    chosen = max(colors, key=lambda color: lower[color] - upper[color])
    return [[chosen, chosen], [chosen, chosen]]
"
